WE BELIEVE IT IS CONTAINED EITHER IN THE CONTAINMENT STRUCTURE OR IN THE BUILDING NEXT DOOR. IT IS NOT BEING DETECTED OFF SITE, EITHER THROUGH THE AIR OR PASSING ONTO LAND/WATERS VIA OVERLAND FLOW OR OTHER CONDUIT (PIPE/ELECTRICAL RACEWAYS, ETC...) WE ARE CAPTURING THE RELEASE IN A BUCKET AND PUMPING IT INTO TOTES. WE ESTIMATE THE AMOUNT TO BE 10-20 GALLONS, BUT DO NOT HAVE AN ACCURATE ESTIMATE OF HOW MUCH WAS RELEASED PRIOR TO OUR CAPTURING ACTIVITIES. OUR EMERGENCY RESPONSE CONTRACTOR IS IN ROUTE AND WE EXPECT THEM TO ARRIVE TODAY TO FINISH UP THE CLEANING ACTIVITIES AND INVESTIGATE

Nearest City: Pine Bluff, AR
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: CHROMIC ACID
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: ALLIED TUBE AND CONDUIT
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 150 gallons
CALLER STATED THAT A VENDOR WAS DOING REPAIRS ON THE ROOF AT THE COMPLEX. DUE TO UNKNOWN CAUSES, A PORTION OF THE ROOF PANEL DROPPED DOWN ONTO A PLASTIC TOTE, CONTAINING A 20 PERCENT SOLUTION OF CHROMIC ACID. THE ROOF PANEL THAT FELL DOWN PUNCTURED A HOLE IN THE SIDE OF THE PLASTIC TOTE, CAUSING A RELEASE OF APPROXIMATELY 150 GALLONS OF MATERIAL ONTO THE ASPHALT GROUND. CREWS WERE ABLE TO CONTAIN THE SPILL, AND GET THE PUNCTURE HOLE SEALED BEFORE THE REST OF THE MATERIAL IN THE TOTE WAS SPILLED. THERE WERE NO INJURIES OR EVACUATION ASSOCIATED WITH THE INCIDENT. VENDOR DOING REPAIRS, DROPPED ROOF PANEL NOTO CONTAINER, OF 20% SOLUTION CHROMIC ACID, RESULTING IN SPILL OF APPROX 150 GALLONS
